title: Prefill: MXFP8 / BF16 GEMMs, router/latent, AttnRes, small ops
shape: NVFP4 1-node DEP16 slice (L24 view: 18 KDA + 6 DSA + 23 MoE layers), F16K at L78K, ms per forward
basis: MEASURED in-step NVFP4 baseline (INFRA 17:48, wzhao/k31ws-int b31121cf56, runs/INFRA/step_p/int-b31121c-nv-f16f8-prof; measured/20261118-1805-nvfp4-prefill.json); achievable = nvfp4_modelopt model at the same slice
gap_analysis: MEASURED per-shape table (M=16384, in-tree cuBLASLt nvjet sm_107 2-CTA tactics): all MXFP8 GEMMs are at the model: KDA in_proj 1083 us = 1.02x (2-CTA 256x256 block-scaled nvjet tactic, so 2x-K is in use; the ledger 1.16-1.40x is stale), KDA o_proj 1.00x, shared gate_up 1.02x, shared down 1.08x. BF16: g_proj 0.97, DSA o_proj 0.94, qb_wq 0.99, qkv_a 1.03, latent_down 1.04, latent_up 1.07, w_uv 1.02, dense gate_up 1.05 - at target. Outliers: router N=896 FP32-out 1.27x (73 vs 58 us), DSA w_uk bmm 1.52x (222 vs 146 us), KDA f_b_proj K=128 1.54x (46 vs 29 us), dense down 1.25x. Sum of my GEMMs: 248.9 ms measured vs 240.8 ms model (1.03x). FlashInfer/cute-dsl/cutlass/trtllm/cudnn MXFP8 backends are all slower than cuBLASLt at M=16384 (cute-dsl 1.14-1.20x, trtllm 2.6-4x). So the family excess is NOT in the GEMM mainloops; it is in the glue: standalone MXFP8 activation quant passes (FlashInfer 40 us per 16384x7168 call = 1.55x its HBM floor; vLLM mxfp8_act producers 81 us = 3.2x their floor, because each thread keeps one 16-B load in flight), the native AttnRes at 1.31-1.37x its byte floor (92-236 us per call), router top-k / latent norm kernels, and (ledger, in-step) the shared experts on the side stream next to the persistent MegaMoE.
inefficiencies: MEASURED: shared SiTU+MXFP8 quant pass 116 us/layer (92/step = 10.7 ms) vs model 9.2 us: MUFU-bound precise tanhf (3 per element); only hideable inside the gate_up GEMM epilogue (SOL design B3). Model error: shared_act / MOE.topk SIMT cost ignores the precise-transcendental MUFU cost when unfused
MEASURED: router top-k 43 us/layer vs 4 us floor (precise sigmoid over 896 logits per token); router GEMM 1.30x (N=896 wave quantization)
MEASURED: standalone MXFP8 quant of the AttnRes output (40 us FlashInfer) per KDA in_proj / shared gate_up call - removed by attn_res_mxfp8 (B1, step A/B running)
MEASURED: native AttnRes 1.31-1.37x its byte floor; fused variant adds 15-25 us (serial per-token epilogue, 1 CTA/SM): needs a 2-token-per-SM redesign (B2)
MEASURED: DSA w_uk bmm 1.52x (P-MLA fuses q-quant into it), KDA f_b_proj 1.54x (402 MB BF16 write), dense down 1.25x
rubin_features: 2-CTA M256 tiles (full-rate operand fetch), exclusive TMEM allocation
oversized shared memory for deeper A/B pipelines
epilogue fusion (MXFP8 quant in producer epilogues)
plan: SOL DESIGN (per 93-layer DEP16 F16K step, model achievable 268.3 ms; bound resources): (A) tensor-bound GEMMs stay on cuBLASLt nvjet sm_107 2-CTA tactics, already 0.94-1.08x (measured), except router N=896 (wave quantization), f_b_proj K=128 (HBM write bound) and w_uk bmm (P-MLA fuses q-quant into it). (B) every HBM-bound glue pass the model prices as fused must disappear: zero standalone MXFP8 quant, zero standalone SiTU pass, router top-k in the router GEMM epilogue, latent RMSNorm in a neighbour. Projected after A+B: ~272 ms (1.01x).

B1 (done, test pending): AttnRes writes the KDA in_proj / shared gate_up MXFP8 input from its RMSNorm epilogue (specialized_prefill/attn_res_mxfp8): -161 quant passes (~6.4 ms) and -69 BF16 writes (~1.2 ms)
B2: AttnRes kernel itself to <=1.1x its byte floor (now 1.31-1.37x): deeper cp.async.bulk ring (CHUNK_DEPTH 3-4 with the oversized smem mode), more rows in flight per SM; projected -5 ms

B3 (largest): shared gate_up GEMM with SiTU + MXFP8 quant epilogue on the FlashInfer sm107 CuTe DSL persistent block-scaled kernel (dual-B TMA: gate rows j and up rows 6144+j in one 256-wide B tile; epilogue rounds to BF16 as cuBLAS, SiTU in FP32, BF16 round, UE8M0 quant); tune its tile/cluster to cuBLASLt speed (now 1.14x default). Removes the 403 MB BF16 write + the MUFU-bound 133 us SiTU+quant pass per layer: projected -11 ms

B4: router top-k into the router GEMM epilogue (896 FP32 logits/row fit in the epilogue warps) or a router GEMM with N tile = 896/4 to kill wave quantization; latent RMSNorm into the latent_up input path; projected -2 to -3 ms
A1: f_b_proj (K=128) fused into its consumer (KDA gate prep, with P-KDA) or a write-bound tile; dense down tactic; projected -1.5 ms
Validate each with the bitwise unit test + 1-GPU bench, then INFRA step_p NVFP4 A/B (EN view)
